blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解大分子產品 Stage 3 持續製程確認 (CPV) 的監控計畫、產品技術團隊 (PTT) 與規格檔案管理
blocks.en: Understand the Stage 3 continued process verification (CPV) monitoring plan, the Product Technical Team (PTT) and specification file management for a large molecule product

blocks.zh: 掌握小分子（注射劑）產品 Stage 1 製程設計中 CQA/CPP 鑑別、風險評估與規模放大的實務做法
blocks.en: Master the practical approach to CQA/CPP identification, risk assessment and scale-up in Stage 1 process design for a small molecule (parenteral) product

blocks.zh: 了解小分子產品 Stage 2 PPQ 執行策略，包含設備確認、技術轉移、安定性批次與 PPQ 批次管理
blocks.en: Understand the Stage 2 PPQ execution strategy for a small molecule product, including equipment qualification, technology transfer, stability batches and PPQ batch management

blocks.zh: 認識小分子產品 Stage 3 CPV 監控指標（PpK/CpK）、PTT 職責與 NDA 補充申請的實務運作
blocks.en: Learn the Stage 3 CPV monitoring metrics (PpK/CpK), PTT responsibilities and the practical handling of NDA supplements for a small molecule product

blocks.zh: 建立對 PV 生命週期法 (Lifecycle Approach) 完整參考文獻體系的認識，連結 ICH、FDA、EMA 與 PDA 標準
blocks.en: Build an understanding of the complete reference framework behind the PV lifecycle approach, linking ICH, FDA, EMA and PDA standards

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Continued Process Verification, CPV（持續製程確認）：這是 PV 生命週期的 Stage 3，製程已獲得核准並進入商業化生產。CPV 的核心目標是透過持續監控證明製程始終維持在「受控狀態 (State of Control)」。
blocks.en: Continued Process Verification (CPV): This is Stage 3 of the PV lifecycle, in which the process has been approved and enters commercial manufacturing. The core goal of CPV is to demonstrate, through ongoing monitoring, that the process remains in a "state of control".

blocks.zh: Preliminary vs. Final Control Limits（初步 vs. 最終管制界限）：本範例展示了一個分階段建立管制界限的策略：先以 15 批建立初步管制界限，再累積至 30 批後確立最終管制界限。這反映了統計上需要足夠的數據量才能得到可靠的製程能力估計。
blocks.en: Preliminary vs. Final Control Limits: This example shows a staged strategy for establishing control limits: preliminary control limits are set using 15 batches, and final control limits are confirmed once 30 batches have accumulated. This reflects the statistical need for sufficient data to obtain reliable estimates of process capability.

blocks.zh: Product Technical Team, PTT（產品技術團隊）：這是一個跨職能團隊，涵蓋製造、製程開發、MSAT、分析、品質與統計。PTT 負責審查商業生產的累積數據，並可建議製程變更以實現持續改善。
blocks.en: Product Technical Team (PTT): This is a cross-functional team covering manufacturing, process development, MSAT, analytical, quality and statistics. The PTT reviews the accumulated commercial manufacturing data and can recommend process changes to achieve continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 如果把 Stage 2 PPQ 比喻成「新餐廳的試營運」，那 Stage 3 CPV 就像是餐廳正式開業後的日常品質巡查。你需要持續監控廚師的出餐品質、客人投訴率、食材耗損等指標。開業前 15 天先建立「初步基準線」，觀察到第 30 天才確立「正式標準」。而 PTT 就像是由主廚、經理、衛生主管、會計等各部門代表組成的「品質管理委員會」，定期審查營運數據。
blocks.en: Think of Stage 2 PPQ as a new restaurant's soft opening, and Stage 3 CPV as the daily quality inspections after the restaurant officially opens. You keep monitoring indicators such as the quality of the chef's dishes, the customer complaint rate and food waste. In the first 15 days you set a "preliminary baseline", and only after observing through day 30 do you fix the "official standard". The PTT is like a "quality committee" made up of representatives from the head chef, the manager, the hygiene supervisor, accounting and other departments, who regularly review operating data.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: CPV 計畫必須在 PPQ 之前就開發完成，並提交給主管機關。這意味著在 Stage 2 啟動前，企業就必須規劃好 Stage 3 的監控策略。這體現了生命週期方法的「前瞻性思維」。
blocks.en: The CPV plan must be developed before PPQ and submitted to the regulatory authority. This means the company must already have planned its Stage 3 monitoring strategy before Stage 2 starts, which reflects the "forward-looking thinking" of the lifecycle approach.

blocks.zh: 規格檔案 (Specification File) 是一份活文件 (Living Document)，從許可證送件時建立，核准後更新為官方認可的參數範圍，並在產品整個生命週期中持續維護。任何製程內或規格的變更都必須記錄在此檔案中。
blocks.en: The Specification File is a living document. It is created at the time of the license submission, updated after approval to the officially accepted parameter ranges, and maintained throughout the entire product lifecycle. Any in-process or specification change must be recorded in this file.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼要分兩階段（15 批和 30 批）來建立管制界限？如果只用 PPQ 的 3-5 批數據來設定管制界限，可能會產生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why are control limits established in two stages (15 batches and 30 batches)? What problems could arise if control limits were set using only the 3-5 PPQ batches?

blocks.zh: PTT 中為什麼需要包含統計人員？他們在 CPV 中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: Why does the PTT need to include a statistician? What role do they play in CPV?

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司有多個生產據點生產同一產品，PTT 審查跨站數據時應該關注哪些方面的一致性？
blocks.en: If your company manufactures the same product at multiple sites, which aspects of consistency should the PTT focus on when reviewing cross-site data?

blocks.zh: 7.2 Small Molecule (Parenteral) 7.2 小分子（注射劑）
blocks.en: 7.2 Small Molecule (Parenteral)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 小分子注射劑 (Small Molecule Parenteral)：與前面 Section 7.1 的大分子（生物藥品）範例不同，本節聚焦於有機小分子的注射劑型。小分子藥品的製程驗證雖然也遵循三階段生命週期法，但在具體操作上有其特點：
blocks.en: Small Molecule Parenteral: Unlike the large molecule (biologic) examples in Section 7.1, this section focuses on parenteral dosage forms of small organic molecules. Process validation for small molecule drugs also follows the three-stage lifecycle approach, but has some specific characteristics in practice:

blocks.zh: 通常不涉及細胞培養或發酵等複雜生物製程
blocks.en: Typically does not involve complex biological processes such as cell culture or fermentation

blocks.zh: API 來自化學合成，可能有多個供應商
blocks.en: The API is produced by chemical synthesis and may come from multiple suppliers

blocks.zh: 製程中的 CQA 更集中在溶解度、pH、含量均一性、雜質等化學特性
blocks.en: CQAs in the process are concentrated on chemical attributes such as solubility, pH, content uniformity and impurities

blocks.zh: 可能涉及無菌充填 (Aseptic Filling) 或終端滅菌 (Terminal Sterilization) 的決策
blocks.en: May involve a decision between aseptic filling and terminal sterilization

blocks.zh: 本範例涉及一個無臨床試驗的產品（治療強度基於生物等效性 Bioequivalence），因此臨床製造經驗相對有限。這影響了 Stage 1 的知識積累程度和風險評估策略。
blocks.en: This example involves a product with no clinical trials (the therapeutic strength is based on bioequivalence), so clinical manufacturing experience is relatively limited. This affects the level of knowledge accumulated in Stage 1 and the risk assessment strategy.

blocks.zh: Table 7.2-1🔍 Stage 1: Process Design (Small Molecule Example) Table 7.2-1🔍 第一階段：製程設計（小分子範例）
blocks.en: Table 7.2-1🔍 Stage 1: Process Design (Small Molecule Example)🔍

blocks.zh: Target Product Profile, TPP & Quality Target Product Profile, QTPP（目標產品概況與品質目標產品概況）：本範例是一個三種濃度的無菌注射液劑型，目標保存期限至少 24 個月（25 °C）。QTPP 的設定是整個 Stage 1 的起點，所有後續的 CQA 鑑別、CPP 確認都圍繞著 QTPP 展開。
blocks.en: Target Product Profile (TPP) & Quality Target Product Profile (QTPP): This example is a sterile injectable solution in three strengths, with a target shelf life of at least 24 months (25 °C). Setting the QTPP is the starting point of the whole of Stage 1, and all subsequent CQA identification and CPP confirmation revolve around it.

blocks.zh: Process Evaluation, PE（製程評估）：這是 Stage 1 中一個關鍵步驟，在安定性批次生產之前進行。本範例使用了兩批全規模 PE 批次（使用來自兩個不同供應商的 API），以建立對 CPP 和 CQA 的全面理解。
blocks.en: Process Evaluation (PE): This is a key step in Stage 1, performed before the stability batches are manufactured. This example used two full-scale PE batches (using API from two different suppliers) to build a comprehensive understanding of the CPPs and CQAs.

blocks.zh: Process Validation Master Plan, PVMP（製程確效主計畫）：一份詳細的總體計畫，列出所有需要執行的確效研究。PVMP 在 Stage 1 即開始規劃，但在 Stage 2 時才最終定案，因為此時所有屬性、參數和系統都已確定。
blocks.en: Process Validation Master Plan (PVMP): A detailed overall plan listing all the validation studies to be performed. The PVMP is started in Stage 1 but is only finalized in Stage 2, when all attributes, parameters and systems have been defined.

blocks.zh: Stage 1 的製程設計就像是建造一棟大樓前的建築設計階段。你需要先決定大樓的用途（QTPP = 三種濃度的注射液），再進行地質勘察（CQA 鑑別），接著做小模型測試（實驗室規模），然後做結構力學計算（DoE 實驗），最後蓋一個實體模型屋（中試規模）來驗證設計可行性。PE 批次就像是在真正的建築基地上蓋一棟「示範屋」，用來驗證所有的設計參數在實際條件下是否可行。
blocks.en: Stage 1 process design is like the architectural design phase before constructing a building. You first decide the building's purpose (QTPP = injectable solution in three strengths), then carry out a geological survey (CQA identification), then test a small model (laboratory scale), then run structural calculations (DoE experiments), and finally build a full-size model house (pilot scale) to verify that the design is feasible. The PE batch is like building a "show house" on the actual construction site to verify that all the design parameters work under real conditions.

blocks.zh: DoE 結果決定了滅菌策略：本範例中，DoE 研究發現藥品對熱敏感，因此決定採用無菌製程 (Aseptic Manufacturing) 而非終端滅菌。這是一個影響深遠的決策，直接影響了設施設計、設備選擇、人員培訓和法規策略。
blocks.en: DoE results determined the sterilization strategy: In this example, the DoE study found that the drug product is heat sensitive, so aseptic manufacturing was chosen instead of terminal sterilization. This is a far-reaching decision that directly affects facility design, equipment selection, personnel training and regulatory strategy.

blocks.zh: 分析方法的階段性驗證策略：PE/示範批次階段使用的分析方法是「適用即可 (Fit-for-Purpose)」但尚未正式驗證。正式驗證在技術轉移至 GMP 生產基地時才完成。這體現了階段適當性方法 (Phase-Appropriate Approach) 的精神。
blocks.en: Staged validation strategy for analytical methods: The analytical methods used at the PE/demonstration batch stage are "fit-for-purpose" but not yet formally validated. Formal validation is completed only when the methods are transferred to the GMP manufacturing site. This reflects the spirit of a phase-appropriate approach.

blocks.zh: 最差情境 (Worst-Case Scenario)：PE 批次在最差條件下生產，以證明即使在極端條件下，產品仍能符合成品規格。這是 PV 中「挑戰製程極限」的核心理念。
blocks.en: Worst-Case Scenario: The PE batches are manufactured under worst-case conditions to demonstrate that the product still meets the finished product specification even under extreme conditions. This is the core idea of "challenging the process limits" in PV.

blocks.zh: 批次規模與取樣策略 Batch Scale & Sampling
blocks.en: Batch Scale & Sampling

blocks.zh: 本範例的關鍵數字：
blocks.en: Key numbers in this example:

blocks.zh: 中試規模：400 L（至少商業規模的 10%）
blocks.en: Pilot scale: 400 L (at least 10% of commercial scale)

blocks.zh: PE 批次規模：2,800 L（全規模）
blocks.en: PE batch size: 2,800 L (full scale)

blocks.zh: 取樣點：10 個取樣點，涵蓋製程開始、中間、結束
blocks.en: Sampling points: 10 sampling points covering the start, middle and end of the process

blocks.zh: 每點取樣：三重複 (Triplicate) 取樣
blocks.en: Samples per point: triplicate sampling

blocks.zh: API 供應商：至少 2 個來源
blocks.en: API suppliers: at least 2 sources

blocks.zh: 配方 pH 水準：至少 3 個
blocks.en: Formulation pH levels: at least 3

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，當客戶帶著一個小分子注射劑配方來尋求製造服務時，你應該在 Stage 1 階段就要求客戶提供以下資訊：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when a client comes to you with a small molecule parenteral formulation and asks for manufacturing services, you should already ask the client in Stage 1 to provide the following information:

blocks.zh: API 的熱穩定性數據（決定無菌充填 vs. 終端滅菌）
blocks.en: Thermal stability data for the API (determines aseptic filling vs. terminal sterilization)

blocks.zh: API 對光和氧氣的敏感性（影響製造環境控制）
blocks.en: Sensitivity of the API to light and oxygen (affects manufacturing environment control)

blocks.zh: API 在不同 pH 下的溶解度和穩定性
blocks.en: Solubility and stability of the API at different pH values

blocks.zh: 已知的 API 供應商及批次間差異
blocks.en: Known API suppliers and batch-to-batch variability

blocks.zh: 容器材料相容性數據
blocks.en: Container material compatibility data

blocks.zh: 這些資訊將直接影響你的報價、時程和設施配置規劃。
blocks.en: This information will directly affect your quotation, timeline and facility allocation planning.

blocks.zh: 為什麼本範例選擇在 PE 批次中使用來自兩個不同供應商的 API？這對 CPP 和 CQA 的建立有什麼意義？
blocks.en: Why does this example use API from two different suppliers in the PE batches? What does this mean for establishing the CPPs and CQAs?

blocks.zh: DoE 研究發現藥品「對熱敏感」後，決定採用無菌製程而非終端滅菌。請列出這個決策對後續 Stage 2 和 Stage 3 的至少三個影響。
blocks.en: After the DoE study found the drug product to be "heat sensitive", aseptic manufacturing was chosen instead of terminal sterilization. List at least three impacts of this decision on Stage 2 and Stage 3.

blocks.zh: 分析方法在 PE 階段「適用即可」但未正式驗證，這在法規上是否可接受？為什麼？
blocks.en: Analytical methods are "fit-for-purpose" but not formally validated at the PE stage. Is this acceptable from a regulatory standpoint? Why?

blocks.zh: Table 7.2-2🔍 Stage 2: Process Qualification (Small Molecule Example) Table 7.2-2🔍 第二階段：製程確效（小分子範例）
blocks.en: Table 7.2-2🔍 Stage 2: Process Qualification (Small Molecule Example)🔍

blocks.zh: Stage Gate Meeting（階段關口會議）：在正式啟動 PPQ 之前，組織會召開「階段關口會議」以確認 PPQ 的準備就緒狀態。這包括確認規格已定案、先前報告已完成、設備與設施已確認、最差情境批次已完成、以及標籤等其他項目的就緒狀態。
blocks.en: Stage Gate Meeting: Before PPQ is formally started, the organization holds a "stage gate meeting" to confirm PPQ readiness. This includes confirming that specifications are finalized, prior reports are complete, equipment and facilities are qualified, worst-case batches have been completed, and other items such as labels are ready.

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次策略：本範例的 PPQ 活動包含 5 批，以濃度為基礎進行分配：最高濃度 3 批、中間濃度 1 批、最低濃度 1 批。這種「以最差情境為重點」的策略是科學化的，因為最高濃度通常代表溶解度、穩定性和均一性的最大挑戰。
blocks.en: PPQ batch strategy: In this example the PPQ activities comprise 5 batches allocated by strength: 3 batches at the highest strength, 1 at the intermediate strength and 1 at the lowest strength. This "worst-case focused" strategy is scientifically sound, because the highest strength usually represents the greatest challenge for solubility, stability and uniformity.

blocks.zh: Matrix Approach（矩陣法）：在安定性研究中採用矩陣法，將不同 API 供應商的批次分配在安定性批次中，以最少的批次涵蓋最多的變異來源。
blocks.en: Matrix Approach: A matrix approach is used in the stability studies, assigning batches made with different API suppliers across the stability batches so that the greatest number of sources of variability is covered with the fewest batches.

blocks.zh: Stage 2 PPQ 就像駕照路考。在考試之前，你需要通過一系列的「準備查核」（Stage Gate）：確認車輛檢驗合格（設備確認）、你已完成足夠的練習時數（PE 批次和安定性批次）、考試路線已確認（製程參數已定案）。正式路考（PPQ 批次）則在標準條件下進行，而不是在暴風雨天或陡峭山路上。因為你已經在練習階段證明了在極端條件下也能安全駕駛（最差情境批次）。
blocks.en: Stage 2 PPQ is like a driving licence road test. Before the test you need to pass a series of "readiness checks" (the stage gate): confirm the vehicle has passed inspection (equipment qualification), you have completed enough practice hours (PE batches and stability batches), and the test route has been confirmed (process parameters finalized). The actual road test (PPQ batches) is then conducted under standard conditions, not in a storm or on a steep mountain road, because you already demonstrated during practice that you can drive safely under extreme conditions (worst-case batches).

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次在常規條件（Nominal Conditions）下執行：這是一個重要的原則。PPQ 的目的是證明製程在日常正常操作條件下能穩定生產合格產品，而不是在極端條件下。最差情境的挑戰已在 Stage 1 的 PE 批次中完成。
blocks.en: PPQ batches are executed under nominal conditions: This is an important principle. The purpose of PPQ is to demonstrate that the process consistently produces acceptable product under normal day-to-day operating conditions, not under extreme conditions. The worst-case challenge was already completed in the Stage 1 PE batches.

blocks.zh: 時程規劃的關鍵：PPQ 批次的時程必須配合 NDA 送件日期。本範例中，DS PPQ 在預計核准日前 12 個月啟動，DP PPQ 在前 9 個月啟動，以確保送件時有至少 1 個月的即時和加速穩定性數據。
blocks.en: Timeline planning is critical: The PPQ batch timeline must fit the NDA submission date. In this example, DS PPQ starts 12 months before the anticipated approval date and DP PPQ starts 9 months before, so that at least 1 month of real-time and accelerated stability data is available at submission.

blocks.zh: Stage 1 + Stage 2 的總批次數：本範例展示了完整的批次清單：3-6 批可行性批次 + 3-6 批配方批次 + 1-2 批 PE 批次 + 3 批安定性批次 + 5 批 PPQ 批次 = 總計約 15-22 批。這是整個 PV 生命週期 Stage 1 和 Stage 2 的完整樣貌。
blocks.en: Total number of batches across Stage 1 + Stage 2: This example shows the complete batch list: 3-6 feasibility batches + 3-6 formulation batches + 1-2 PE batches + 3 stability batches + 5 PPQ batches = approximately 15-22 batches in total. This is the full picture of Stage 1 and Stage 2 of the PV lifecycle.

blocks.zh: PPQ 時程規劃參考 Timeline Planning
blocks.en: PPQ Timeline Planning Reference

blocks.zh:
預計核准日 (Approval Date)
    |
    |- 12 個月前：啟動 DS PPQ 批次
    |- 9 個月前：啟動 DP PPQ 批次
    |- 送件時：至少 1 個月即時+加速穩定性數據
    |
安定性條件：
    - 長期：2-8 °C / 60% RH
    - 加速：30 °C / 65% RH
    - 極端：40 °C / 75% RH

PPQ 批次分配（5 批）：
    - 最高濃度：3 批（含 1 批 hold study）
    - 中間濃度：1 批
    - 最低濃度：1 批
blocks.en:
Anticipated Approval Date
    |
    |- 12 months before: start DS PPQ batches
    |- 9 months before: start DP PPQ batches
    |- At submission: at least 1 month of real-time + accelerated stability data
    |
Stability conditions:
    - Long-term: 2-8 °C / 60% RH
    - Accelerated: 30 °C / 65% RH
    - Stress: 40 °C / 75% RH

PPQ batch allocation (5 batches):
    - Highest strength: 3 batches (including 1 hold study batch)
    - Intermediate strength: 1 batch
    - Lowest strength: 1 batch

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PPQ 批次在「常規條件」下執行，而不是在最差情境下？這與 Stage 1 PE 批次的角色如何互補？
blocks.en: Why are PPQ batches executed under "nominal conditions" rather than worst-case conditions? How does this complement the role of the Stage 1 PE batches?

blocks.zh: 本範例的清潔驗證是與 PPQ 批次「同時 (Concurrently)」進行的。請說明同步執行清潔驗證的優點和潛在風險。
blocks.en: In this example, cleaning validation is performed "concurrently" with the PPQ batches. Explain the advantages and potential risks of running cleaning validation concurrently.

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品有三種濃度，為什麼最高濃度需要 3 批而較低濃度只需 1-2 批？請從科學和風險的角度解釋。
blocks.en: If your product has three strengths, why does the highest strength need 3 batches while the lower strengths need only 1-2? Explain from a scientific and risk perspective.

blocks.zh: Table 7.2-3🔍 Stage 3: Continued Process Verification (Small Molecule Example) Table 7.2-3🔍 第三階段：持續製程驗證（小分子範例）
blocks.en: Table 7.2-3🔍 Stage 3: Continued Process Verification (Small Molecule Example)🔍

blocks.zh: PpK 與 CpK（製程績效指標與製程能力指標）：
blocks.en: PpK and CpK (Process Performance Index and Process Capability Index):

blocks.zh: PpK (Process Performance Index)：使用全部數據的標準差計算，反映製程的「整體績效」，適用於初期數據較少時
blocks.en: PpK (Process Performance Index): Calculated using the overall standard deviation of all data, reflecting the "overall performance" of the process; suitable when little data is available at the beginning

blocks.zh: CpK (Process Capability Index)：使用組內標準差計算，反映製程的「固有能力」，需要數據量較大（本範例建議 25 點以上）
blocks.en: CpK (Process Capability Index): Calculated using the within-group standard deviation, reflecting the "inherent capability" of the process; requires a larger amount of data (25 or more points are recommended in this example)

blocks.zh: 兩者值越大，表示製程越穩定、越遠離規格界限。一般目標值為 ≥ 1.33
blocks.en: The higher the value, the more stable the process and the farther it is from the specification limits. The general target value is ≥ 1.33

blocks.zh: Process-Robustness Contour Plots（製程穩健性等高線圖）：當數據點少於 20-25 個時，傳統的製程能力分析可能不可靠。等高線圖提供了一種視覺化方法，展示多個製程參數與品質屬性之間的關係，幫助識別「穩健操作區域」。
blocks.en: Process-Robustness Contour Plots: When there are fewer than 20-25 data points, conventional process capability analysis may be unreliable. Contour plots provide a visual method that shows the relationship between multiple process parameters and quality attributes, helping to identify a "robust operating region".

blocks.zh: PpK/CpK 就像是學生的考試成績分析。PpK 看的是你所有考試的「整體表現」（包含好的和差的），CpK 則看的是你在「正常發揮」情況下的能力。如果你的 CpK 很高但 PpK 偏低，表示你有能力但不穩定（可能偶爾失常）；如果兩者都高，表示你既有實力又穩定。藥廠追求的目標就是讓 PpK 和 CpK 都 ≥ 1.33，就像學生每次考試都能穩定考在 90 分以上。
blocks.en: PpK/CpK are like analyzing a student's exam results. PpK looks at your "overall performance" across all exams (good and bad), while CpK looks at your ability when you are "performing normally". If your CpK is high but your PpK is low, you are capable but inconsistent (occasionally having an off day); if both are high, you are both capable and consistent. The goal for a pharmaceutical company is to have both PpK and CpK ≥ 1.33, like a student who scores above 90 on every exam.

blocks.zh: Stage 3 是一個「漫長且持續進化」的階段：本範例特別提到，在長期的 Stage 3 中進行了 PAT（製程分析技術）、DOE、連續製程實驗和臨床研究，以改善產品線。這體現了 Stage 3 不僅僅是「維護」，更是「持續改善」的機會。
blocks.en: Stage 3 is a "long and continually evolving" stage: This example specifically mentions that during the long Stage 3, PAT (process analytical technology), DoE, continuous process experiments and clinical studies were carried out to improve the product line. This shows that Stage 3 is not just "maintenance" but also an opportunity for continual improvement.

blocks.zh: NDA 補充申請 (NDA Supplements)：在產品的生命週期中，可能需要新增製造和測試設施。每次新增都需要進行技術轉移和製程確效，並提交 NDA 補充申請。這意味著 Stage 2 的某些活動可能在 Stage 3 中反覆執行。
blocks.en: NDA Supplements: During the product lifecycle, new manufacturing and testing facilities may need to be added. Each addition requires technology transfer and process validation, and an NDA supplement must be submitted. This means some Stage 2 activities may be repeated within Stage 3.

blocks.zh: 製程理解檔案的持續維護：這份檔案不是 PPQ 結束後就歸檔的靜態文件。它必須在產品整個生命週期中持續更新，納入所有新的研究結果和製程/規格變更。
blocks.en: Ongoing maintenance of the process understanding file: This file is not a static document to be archived once PPQ ends. It must be continuously updated throughout the product lifecycle to incorporate all new study results and process/specification changes.

blocks.zh: 統計工具選擇指引 Statistical Tool Selection
blocks.en: Statistical Tool Selection

blocks.zh:
數據點數量          推薦工具
─────────────────────────────────
< 20-25 個         製程穩健性等高線圖
                    (Contour Plots)

≥ 25 個            PpK 和/或 CpK
                    (Capability Indices)

目標值：PpK, CpK ≥ 1.33
（表示製程中心距離規格界限
  至少 4 個標準差）
blocks.en:
Number of data points     Recommended tool
─────────────────────────────────
< 20-25                 Process-robustness contour plots
                          (Contour Plots)

≥ 25                      PpK and/or CpK
                          (Capability Indices)

Target value: PpK, CpK ≥ 1.33
(meaning the process center is at least
  4 standard deviations from the specification limit)

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，Stage 3 的多廠區管理是核心挑戰。當客戶要求在第二個生產據點生產同一產品時，你需要：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, multi-site management in Stage 3 is a core challenge. When a client asks to manufacture the same product at a second manufacturing site, you need to:

blocks.zh: 準備 NDA 補充申請的文件套件
blocks.en: Prepare the document package for the NDA supplement

blocks.zh: 執行完整的技術轉移程序（參考 PDA TR65）
blocks.en: Execute a complete technology transfer procedure (refer to PDA TR65)

blocks.zh: 在新據點重新執行 PPQ（Stage 2 活動在 Stage 3 中循環）
blocks.en: Re-execute PPQ at the new site (Stage 2 activities recur within Stage 3)

blocks.zh: 將新據點數據納入 PTT 的跨站比較分析
blocks.en: Include the new site's data in the PTT's cross-site comparative analysis

blocks.zh: 更新製程理解檔案以反映多站生產的知識
blocks.en: Update the process understanding file to reflect knowledge from multi-site manufacturing

blocks.zh: 為什麼在數據點少於 20-25 個時不建議直接使用 CpK？從統計學角度解釋其局限性。
blocks.en: Why is it not recommended to use CpK directly when there are fewer than 20-25 data points? Explain its limitations from a statistical perspective.

blocks.zh: PTT 在 Stage 3 中可以建議製程變更。請思考：什麼類型的變更可以在既有 NDA 框架內進行，什麼類型需要提交補充申請？
blocks.en: The PTT can recommend process changes in Stage 3. Consider: what types of changes can be made within the existing NDA framework, and what types require an NDA supplement?

blocks.zh: 如果你觀察到某個 CQA 的 PpK 從 1.5 逐漸下降到 1.1，你會採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: If you observe the PpK of a CQA gradually declining from 1.5 to 1.1, what action would you take?

blocks.zh: 8.0 References / 參考文獻
blocks.en: 8.0 References

blocks.zh: 參考文獻分類解析 Reference Classification
blocks.en: Reference Classification

blocks.zh: TR60 的參考文獻可分為以下幾大類，反映了製程確效生命週期法的多面向知識體系：
blocks.en: The references of TR60 can be divided into the following main categories, reflecting the multifaceted body of knowledge behind the process validation lifecycle approach:

blocks.zh: 1. 法規指引 (Regulatory Guidance)：
blocks.en: 1. Regulatory Guidance:

blocks.zh: FDA：Ref #1（Process Validation Guidance 2011）是本報告的核心參考文獻，定義了三階段生命週期法的框架
blocks.en: FDA: Ref #1 (Process Validation Guidance 2011) is the core reference of this report and defines the framework of the three-stage lifecycle approach

blocks.zh: EMA：Ref #2, #3, #50 涵蓋歐盟 GMP 和製程確效指引
blocks.en: EMA: Refs #2, #3 and #50 cover EU GMP and process validation guidance

blocks.zh: ICH：Ref #4 (Q12), #5 (Q10), #10 (Q13), #11 (Q2), #15 (Q7), #17 (Q8) 等構成品質管理的國際標準框架
blocks.en: ICH: Refs #4 (Q12), #5 (Q10), #10 (Q13), #11 (Q2), #15 (Q7), #17 (Q8) and others form the international standards framework for quality management

blocks.zh: 2. PDA 技術報告 (PDA Technical Reports)：
blocks.en: 2. PDA Technical Reports:

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證 (TR29)、無菌製程模擬 (TR22)、滅菌確效 (TR1, TR3)
blocks.en: Cleaning validation (TR29), aseptic process simulation (TR22), sterilization validation (TR1, TR3)

blocks.zh: 技術轉移 (TR65)、品質風險管理 (TR54 系列)
blocks.en: Technology transfer (TR65), quality risk management (TR54 series)

blocks.zh: 分析方法 (TR57)、核准後變更管理 (TR91)
blocks.en: Analytical methods (TR57), post-approval change management (TR91)

blocks.zh: TR60 的延伸附錄 (TR60-2 口服固體、TR60-3 生物藥 DS)
blocks.en: Extension appendices of TR60 (TR60-2 oral solid dosage, TR60-3 biologic DS)

blocks.zh: 3. 業界標準 (Industry Standards)：
blocks.en: 3. Industry Standards:

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500、E2363：製藥設備確認和 PAT 術語標準
blocks.en: ASTM E2500, E2363: standards for pharmaceutical equipment qualification and PAT terminology

blocks.zh: ISPE Baseline Guide 和 Good Practice Guide
blocks.en: ISPE Baseline Guides and Good Practice Guides

blocks.zh: 這份參考文獻清單就像是製程確效專業人員的「必備書單」。就像醫學院學生需要同時精通解剖學、生理學、藥理學和臨床醫學一樣，PV 專業人員需要同時掌握法規要求（FDA/EMA/ICH）、技術標準（PDA/ISPE/ASTM）、以及具體的驗證技術（滅菌、清潔、分析方法等）。這 62 篇參考文獻構成了一個完整的「知識生態系統」，每一篇都在整體框架中扮演特定角色。
blocks.en: This reference list is like the "must-read book list" for process validation professionals. Just as medical students need to master anatomy, physiology, pharmacology and clinical medicine together, PV professionals need to master regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA/ICH), technical standards (PDA/ISPE/ASTM) and specific validation techniques (sterilization, cleaning, analytical methods, etc.) together. These 62 references form a complete "knowledge ecosystem", and each one plays a specific role in the overall framework.

blocks.zh: 核心必讀文獻（優先閱讀順序）：
blocks.en: Core must-read references (in priority reading order):

blocks.zh: Ref #1 - FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)：三階段生命週期法的源頭文件
blocks.en: Ref #1 - FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011): the source document of the three-stage lifecycle approach

blocks.zh: Ref #5 - ICH Q10：Pharmaceutical Quality System，所有品質活動的基礎框架
blocks.en: Ref #5 - ICH Q10: Pharmaceutical Quality System, the foundational framework for all quality activities

blocks.zh: Ref #17 - ICH Q8(R2)：Pharmaceutical Development，QbD 方法論的核心
blocks.en: Ref #17 - ICH Q8(R2): Pharmaceutical Development, the core of the QbD methodology

blocks.zh: Ref #4 - ICH Q12：Lifecycle Management，連結開發與商業化的橋樑
blocks.en: Ref #4 - ICH Q12: Lifecycle Management, the bridge linking development and commercialization

blocks.zh: Ref #2 - EMA PV Guideline：歐盟法規視角的互補
blocks.en: Ref #2 - EMA PV Guideline: a complementary view from the EU regulatory perspective

blocks.zh: TR60 延伸附錄的價值：
blocks.en: Value of the TR60 extension appendices:

blocks.zh: Ref #53 - TR60-2：口服固體劑型/半固體劑型的專門指引
blocks.en: Ref #53 - TR60-2: dedicated guidance for oral solid and semi-solid dosage forms

blocks.zh: Ref #52 - TR60-3：生物藥品原料藥製造的專門指引
blocks.en: Ref #52 - TR60-3: dedicated guidance for biologic drug substance manufacturing

blocks.zh: 這些附錄提供了 TR60 主報告未深入涵蓋的劑型/產品類型的詳細實務指引。
blocks.en: These appendices provide detailed practical guidance for dosage forms and product types that the main TR60 report does not cover in depth.

blocks.zh: 如果你正在為一個新的生物藥品（單株抗體）進行製程確效，從這 62 篇參考文獻中，你會優先選擇哪 5 篇作為核心指引？請說明選擇理由。
blocks.en: If you were carrying out process validation for a new biologic (monoclonal antibody), which 5 of these 62 references would you choose first as core guidance? Explain your reasons.

blocks.zh: FDA 的 Process Validation Guidance (2011) 和 EMA 的 PV Guideline (2016) 在三階段定義上有何主要差異？為什麼理解兩者的差異對國際化 CDMO 很重要？
blocks.en: What are the main differences in the three-stage definitions between the FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011) and the EMA PV Guideline (2016)? Why is understanding these differences important for an international CDMO?

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 (Lifecycle Management) 與製程確效的 Stage 3 (CPV) 之間有什麼關聯？它如何影響核准後的製程變更管理？
blocks.en: How does ICH Q12 (Lifecycle Management) relate to Stage 3 (CPV) of process validation? How does it affect post-approval process change management?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 大分子 Stage 3 CPV：透過 CPV 計畫進行持續監控，以 15 批建立初步管制界限、30 批建立最終管制界限。PTT 跨職能團隊負責長期監督，規格檔案作為活文件持續維護。
blocks.en: Large molecule Stage 3 CPV: Ongoing monitoring is carried out through the CPV plan, with preliminary control limits set at 15 batches and final control limits at 30 batches. The cross-functional PTT provides long-term oversight, and the specification file is maintained as a living document.

blocks.zh: 小分子 Stage 1 製程設計：從 TPP/QTPP 出發，透過 DoE 確定滅菌策略（無菌充填 vs. 終端滅菌）。PE 批次在全規模下以最差情境執行，建立 CPP 和 CQA 的完整理解。分析方法採「適用即可」策略，在技術轉移時正式驗證。
blocks.en: Small molecule Stage 1 process design: Starting from the TPP/QTPP, the sterilization strategy (aseptic filling vs. terminal sterilization) is determined through DoE. PE batches are executed at full scale under worst-case conditions to build a complete understanding of the CPPs and CQAs. Analytical methods follow a "fit-for-purpose" strategy and are formally validated at technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 小分子 Stage 2 PPQ：設備確認基於風險評估、安定性批次採矩陣法涵蓋多個 API 供應商、PPQ 在常規條件下執行 5 批（以最高濃度為重點）。時程必須配合 NDA 送件日期。
blocks.en: Small molecule Stage 2 PPQ: Equipment qualification is based on risk assessment, stability batches use a matrix approach to cover multiple API suppliers, and PPQ is executed as 5 batches under nominal conditions (with emphasis on the highest strength). The timeline must fit the NDA submission date.

blocks.zh: 小分子 Stage 3 CPV：根據數據量選擇適當的統計工具（等高線圖或 PpK/CpK）。PTT 持續監督並推動改善，NDA 補充申請支持新據點和新設施的擴展。
blocks.en: Small molecule Stage 3 CPV: Appropriate statistical tools (contour plots or PpK/CpK) are selected according to the amount of data. The PTT provides ongoing oversight and drives improvement, and NDA supplements support expansion to new sites and facilities.

blocks.zh: 參考文獻體系：62 篇參考文獻涵蓋 FDA/EMA/ICH 法規指引、PDA 技術報告、ASTM/ISPE 業界標準，構成製程確效生命週期法的完整知識框架。FDA PV Guidance (2011) 和 ICH Q8/Q10/Q12 是核心必讀文獻。
blocks.en: Reference framework: The 62 references cover FDA/EMA/ICH regulatory guidance, PDA technical reports and ASTM/ISPE industry standards, forming a complete knowledge framework for the process validation lifecycle approach. The FDA PV Guidance (2011) and ICH Q8/Q10/Q12 are the core must-read references.
